final: WITH g AS (SELECT BillingState AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT g.st, g.cnt, 1.0*g.cnt/s.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM p WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT p.cnt, p.ratio, p.cnt - a.av AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE p.cnt > a.av) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
